about.metaDescription: Volontyorlar was founded on 4 June 2025 by Arslon Rajabov and Parizoda Abdurakhimova to help high school students in Uzbekistan find meaningful volunteering.
about.title: About Volontyorlar
about.lead: A volunteering community for high school students in Uzbekistan, built by people who were tired of watching good opportunities disappear into a feed.

founded.title: Founded in June 2025
founded.body: Volontyorlar was founded on 4 June 2025 by Arslon Rajabov and Parizoda Abdurakhimova to help high school students discover and apply to meaningful volunteering opportunities.

purpose.title: Why it exists
purpose.body: Volunteering is not hard to want. It is hard to find. Opportunities are scattered across channels, organisers do not always know where to look for people, and a student who wants to help often has nowhere obvious to start. Volontyorlar exists to close that gap.

growth.title: From reposting to running operations
growth.body: Volontyorlar began by sharing opportunities it found elsewhere. Today it finds opportunities, contacts organisers, sources events, builds partnerships, supplies volunteers, and is building regional operations across the country.

numbers.title: Where we are now
numbers.lead: Every figure on this page is something we can account for.

volunteering.metaDescription: How volunteering with Volontyorlar works: how opportunities are found and checked, how they reach you, and what happens at the event.
volunteering.title: How volunteering with Volontyorlar works
volunteering.lead: You do not need experience, a contact inside an organisation, or a plan. You need to be reachable when something good comes up.

start.title: Where to start
start.body: Join the community channel. Opportunities are posted there as we confirm them, with what the event is, where it is, and what the organiser needs.

real.title: Real events
real.description: We only share opportunities after speaking to the organiser.

clear.title: Clear requirements
clear.description: Every opportunity says what the organiser is actually asking for.

support.title: Someone to ask
support.description: If something is unclear, you ask us rather than guessing.

items.show: If you say you are coming, come.
items.time: Tell us early if your plans change, so the organiser can fill your place.
items.respect: Treat organisers, other volunteers, and the people an event is for with respect.

app.title: The Volontyorlar application
app.body: Browsing opportunities, applying, and keeping a record of the events you attended belong to the separate Volontyorlar application, not to this website.
app.pending: The application is being built separately. Until it is available, opportunities are shared through our community channel.

work.title: Working with Volontyorlar
work.body: If your organisation is running an event that needs volunteers, or you want to work with us in a region, get in touch.

contact.metaDescription: How to reach Volontyorlar: for young people who want to volunteer, and for organisers and partners who need volunteers.
contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: The quickest way to reach Volontyorlar is through our public channels.

channels.title: Public channels
channels.empty: Channel addresses are being confirmed and will be listed here.

volunteers.title: If you want to volunteer
volunteers.body: Join the community. Opportunities are posted as we confirm them, and you can ask questions there.

organisers.title: If you are an organiser
organisers.body: Tell us what your event is, when it is, and how many volunteers you need. We will tell you honestly whether we can supply them.

regional.title: If you want to help in your region
regional.body: We are building regional teams across Uzbekistan. Get in touch through a public channel and say where you are.

privacy.metaDescription: What happens to your information on the Volontyorlar website: no accounts, no forms, no cookies, and no analytics.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: This page describes the Volontyorlar website you are reading. It does not cover the separate Volontyorlar application.

collection.title: We do not collect personal data here
collection.body: This website has no accounts, no sign-in, no forms, and no comment fields. There is nothing for you to submit, so there is nothing for us to store.

cookies.title: No cookies
cookies.body: The site sets no cookies. The only thing it keeps in your browser is your choice of light or dark theme, which stays on your device and is never sent to us. Your language is part of the address of the page you are reading, not something we remember about you.

analytics.title: No analytics or tracking
analytics.body: No analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking script runs on this website, and no third-party fonts or embeds are loaded.

logs.title: Server logs
logs.body: Like any website, your request reaches a hosting provider that may keep short-lived technical logs, such as an IP address and browser type. We do not use those logs to identify visitors.

links.title: Links to other services
links.body: Links to Telegram, Instagram, or the Volontyorlar application take you to services with their own privacy practices. This page does not cover them.

app.title: The Volontyorlar application
app.body: The separate Volontyorlar application handles volunteer profiles and applications. It has its own privacy terms, and nothing on this website is connected to it.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Ask through one of our public channels.

terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the Volontyorlar website: what it is, what it is not, and what it does not promise.
terms.title: Terms
terms.lead: These terms cover this website. The separate Volontyorlar application has its own.

purpose.title: What this site is
purpose.body: This website is informational. It describes Volontyorlar, the organisations we work with, and how volunteering with us works. It is not a place to apply, sign in, or manage a volunteer profile.

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.body: We publish only information we can confirm. Details about events and partners can still change, and pages may be out of date between updates.

placement.title: No guarantee of a place
placement.body: Reading this website does not enrol you in anything and does not guarantee a place at any event. Volunteer places are decided together with the organiser of each event.

conduct.title: Using the site
conduct.body: Do not attempt to disrupt the site, and do not use it to mislead anyone about Volontyorlar or the organisations named on it.

brand.title: Our name and mark
brand.body: The Volontyorlar name and mark belong to Volontyorlar. Do not use them in a way that implies a partnership that does not exist.

external.title: External links
external.body: We link to other organisations and services. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: These terms can change. The date above shows the last update.
